# leak-gate: forbidden PATH patterns (clean-room red lines)
#
# One POSIX ERE per line. Blank lines and lines starting with "#" are comments.
# Each pattern is matched (unanchored, case-insensitively) against every line of
# `git ls-files`. ANY match fails the build.
#
# ── Maintenance rules (read before editing) ────────────────────────────────
# 1. NEVER hard-code a numeric range. The pre-CI manual pattern used
#    `design/000[1-5]`, which only covered design docs 0001-0005 while pro had
#    long since reached 0006+ -> the check could not see the new ones. Always
#    write the STRUCTURAL form (`docs/design/`), never an enumeration.
# 2. Substring (unanchored) matching is deliberate. `research/` also matches
#    `some/nested/research/`. Broader is the safe direction for a leak gate;
#    do not "tighten" a pattern to make a build go green.
# 3. Adding a pattern is a normal change. REMOVING or narrowing one requires
#    an owner ruling -- see the header of ../workflows/leak-gate.yml.
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# --- Reverse-engineering working data. Must never exist in the public repo. ---
research/
raw/

# --- Vendor binaries / archives that can carry vendor IP. ---
# `.zip` is here because the clean-room ignore list is
# `research/`, `raw/`, `*.apk`, `*.zip` -- the archives are how the whole
# `research/` tree travels, so blocking only the directory is not enough.
\.apk$
\.zip$

# Extension (not in the original manual pattern): binaries this repo's own
# .gitignore already calls out as "Compiled / native / decompiled binaries --
# NEVER commit (vendor IP risk)". .gitignore only stops accidents; it does
# nothing about `git add -f` or a file committed before the rule existed.
\.aab$
\.so$
\.dex$
\.aar$
\.smali$

# --- Internal-only documents. These live in pro and nowhere else. ---
distribution-decision
ios-port-plan
docs/design/
engineer-app-notes/
testflight-metadata
i18n-plan

# --- Internal working-state markers used by pro's research notes. ---
UNVERIFIED
CAPTURE_VERIFIED
HCI_CAPTURE_GUIDE
